```artifact
GUI_EVENT_GRAPH:
  START
    -
    -> SET_HIGH_RR_THRESHOLD
  SET_HIGH_RR_THRESHOLD
    INPUT: slider_threshold_high_rr (5-30, step 1)
    VALIDATE: slider_threshold_high_rr ∈ [5, 30]
    -> IF_VALID_SET_HIGH_RR_THRESHOLD
    -> IF_INVALID_SET_HIGH_RR_THRESHOLD
  IF_VALID_SET_HIGH_RR_THRESHOLD
    ASSERT: threshold_high_rr = slider_threshold_high_rr
    -> SET_LOW_RR_THRESHOLD
  IF_INVALID_SET_HIGH_RR_THRESHOLD
    ASSERT: error_message_shown = "Threshold must be between 5 and 30"
    -> SET_HIGH_RR_THRESHOLD
  SET_LOW_RR_THRESHOLD
    INPUT: slider_threshold_low_rr (5-30, step 1)
    VALIDATE: slider_threshold_low_rr ∈ [5, 30]
    -> IF_VALID_SET_LOW_RR_THRESHOLD
    -> IF_INVALID_SET_LOW_RR_THRESHOLD
  IF_VALID_SET_LOW_RR_THRESHOLD
    ASSERT: threshold_low_rr = slider_threshold_low_rr
    -> SET_Apnea_THRESHOLD
  IF_INVALID_SET_LOW_RR_THRESHOLD
    ASSERT: error_message_shown = "Threshold must be between 5 and 30"
    -> SET_LOW_RR_THRESHOLD
  SET_Apnea_THRESHOLD
    INPUT: slider_threshold_apnea (1-30, step 1)
    VALIDATE: slider_threshold_apnea ∈ [1, 30]
    -> IF_VALID_SET_Apnea_THRESHOLD
    -> IF_INVALID_SET_Apnea_THRESHOLD
  IF_VALID_SET_Apnea_THRESHOLD
    ASSERT: threshold_apnea = slider_threshold_apnea
    -> DETECT_RELIEF_VALVE_OPEN
  IF_INVALID_SET_Apnea_THRESHOLD
    ASSERT: error_message_shown = "Threshold must be between 1 and 30"
    -> SET_Apnea_THRESHOLD
  DETECT_RELIEF_VALVE_OPEN
    INPUT: flow_sensor_data (unexpected increase)
    VALIDATE: flow_sensor_data > expected_flow_rate
    ASSERT: alarm_relief_valve_open = true
    -> END
```
